items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: so I took my sister out to get Doodles’ signed.

ctx.x: Yes exactly. Well I didn’t know anything about jazz but I knew there had to be something more than Dixieland because I heard people talking about it in high school. But anyway, so I took my sister out to get Doodles’ signed. And it was in this lovely country hotel and there was a guy playing piano who was a local piano player, and so they were very nice to us little girls and he signed his picture. And he said, “What do you want to do when you grow up?” I said well singing. He said, “Well sing something.” So I…
